name: M4 NAT
description: M4 item 3 NAT client fixture; run id is added by the hardware driver.

nodes.name: R1
nodes.startupConfig:
hostname R1
!
ip routing
access-list 1 permit 192.168.1.0 0.0.0.255
interface Ethernet0/0
 ip address 192.168.1.1 255.255.255.0
 ip nat inside
 no shutdown
!
interface Ethernet0/1
 ip address dhcp
 ip nat outside
 no shutdown
!
ip nat inside source list 1 interface Ethernet0/1 overload
end
